name: Bucho
source:
The head of the “Paradise Research” club at Koganecho Academy. Dressed in a black coat, everything about him is shrouded in mystery. He seems to be investigating the belief that “you can go to Paradise after death”......

[Taken from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/11/10/manimani/]Official Website[/url]]

[spoiler]His name is Rou[ロー].
